intent_instructions:
Re-classify intent. ONLY valid JSON per schema below.
intent_type: "quiz" (greeting/thanks/static trivia answerable without tools) or "agentic" (everything else). NOT quiz: real-time/time-sensitive, web/tools/files needed, not answerable from training knowledge alone, follow-ups, or questions about this agent's runtime state (workspace, cwd, configured model, available tools, current loop/goal, policies, environment) → "agentic".
When "quiz": quiz_response (concise direct answer). When "agentic": task_complexity only. task_complexity: minimal|simple|medium|complex.
JSON schema: {{ "intent_type": "quiz"|"agentic", "task_complexity": "minimal"|"simple"|"medium"|"complex", "quiz_response": string|null }}
